from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0045.png").convert("RGB"))

# Current pose after frame 45:
# Frame 44 pose: xc=-0.495, yc=4.336, th=225
# Frame 45 action: turn_deg=45 -> th=270 deg (pointing straight west, -x direction)
# move_m=0.5 along 270 deg: dx = 0.5 * sin(270) = -0.5, dy = 0.5 * cos(270) = 0
# xc = -0.495 - 0.5 = -0.995, yc = 4.336
xc, yc, th = -0.995, 4.336, np.radians(270.0)
f, H = 256.0, 1.55

# Measure potted plant:
pot_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 140) & (img[:, :, 0] < 200) & (img[:, :, 1] > 60) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] < 70)
pts = np.argwhere(pot_mask)
print(f"Pot pixels: {len(pts)}")
min_u, max_u = pts[:, 1].min(), pts[:, 1].max()
max_v = pts[:, 0].max()
center_u = (min_u + max_u) / 2.0
bottom_u = pts[pts[:, 0] == max_v, 1].mean()
print(f"u range: [{min_u}, {max_u}], center_u={center_u:.1f}, bottom_u={bottom_u:.1f}, max_v={max_v}")

Zc = f * H / (max_v - 256.0)
Xc = (center_u - 256.0) * H / (max_v - 256.0)
# th = 270 deg:
# Xw = xc + Xc*cos(270) + Zc*sin(270) = xc - Zc
# Yw = yc - Xc*sin(270) + Zc*cos(270) = yc + Xc
Xw = xc - Zc
Yw = yc + Xc
print(f"Potted plant center from obs_0045: ({Xw:.3f}, {Yw:.3f}), Zc={Zc:.3f}, Xc={Xc:.3f}")
'
